headline: EPS surges year-over-year and sequentially
summary_short: Inpex reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥132.25, up 62.9% y/y from ¥81.19.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥132.25 rose 62.9% year-over-year from ¥81.19, and was up 40.6% sequentially from ¥94.08 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
